name: calibre
title: Calibre
description: The Calibre desktop program for e-books, used through the browser: add, convert and edit books and their metadata. The library is kept in App-Data/Calibre/config, which is the folder Calibre-Web can read. Anyone who can open the page controls the desktop, so set a password below or keep it behind the sign-in page; browsers want HTTPS for the desktop, which a route or the HTTPS port gives.

variables.name: PORT_CALIBRE
variables.label: Desktop port
variables.description: Port for the Calibre desktop in the browser (HTTP)

variables.name: PORT_CALIBRE_HTTPS
variables.label: Desktop port (HTTPS)
variables.description: The same desktop over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate, for use without a route

variables.name: PORT_CALIBRE_SERVER
variables.label: Content server port
variables.description: Port of Calibre's own content server, after you switch it on under Preferences > Sharing over the net

variables.name: CALIBRE_USER
variables.label: User name
variables.description: Name for the sign-in in front of the desktop (only asked when a password is set)

variables.name: CALIBRE_PASSWORD
variables.label: Password
variables.description: Password in front of the desktop; empty for none
